intro: Meraki makes your living space effortlessly elegant. A harmonious blend of elegance and functionality. Its two-level surface and stylish finish redefine convenience and sophistication.

features.title: A timeless touch of warmth
features.text: The timeless two-tone finish adds warmth and elegance, making it a standout centerpiece for any living room.

features.title: Storage that works for you
features.text: Provides an easy-access space for books, décor, or gadgets, making organisation stylish and practical.

features.title: More space, less mess
features.text: Designed for dual functionality, the two-level layout provides ample space for décor, books, and essentials.

features.title: Made for every moment
features.text: From cosy evenings with family to hosting friends, this table adapts effortlessly to your lifestyle. Its sleek design complements contemporary, modern, and transitional interiors.

features.title: Easy setup, zero stress
features.text: Enjoy hassle-free assembly with its user-friendly knockdown construction. The compact packaging also makes it easy to transport, so you can set it up effortlessly anywhere you desire.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
